case.summary: Investigation HHG-016 was initiated following a customer report from C09988 denying an online transaction of $59.67 on card C09988-K1 on 2016-12-11. The transaction (ID 3534820) was conducted via a new Windows device with Edge 16.0, which has never been associated with this cardholder. The customer confirmed they did not authorize the transaction, still possess the card, and do not share it. Based on the customer's denial and similar prior fraud cases (such as CC-3353 and CC-3356), the transaction is confirmed as fraud under the card_not_present_new_device pattern.

evidence_requests.assumed_response: Customer confirms they did not make the purchase(s), still has the card, and no one else uses it

initial.reason: R2 precondition: confirm the unauthorised use (card in possession, no household use) before blocking
Section 3a: fraud probability >= 0.30 or evidence requested
R1: keep the card active but watched while the dispute is verified

final.reason: R2: customer denies the transaction; exposure $59.67 <= $2,500 so route L1
Section 3a / R2: fraud probability above 0.30; open the internal case and write it to the graph

next_best_actions.what_changed: The initial recommendation was to verify with the customer and monitor the card. Upon the customer's explicit denial of the transaction, the final action was escalated to blocking the card and creating a case under policy rule R2.

sar.reason: Case only, no report: exposure $59.67 is under $1,000, no shared device, region cluster or link to another customer's fraud, and the pattern is documented (section 3a).

stop_reason: Pursuant to policy section 6, no regulatory report is required because the total exposure of $59.67 is below the $1,000 threshold, and there are no shared device profiles or links to other fraudulent accounts.
